Fine-grained persisted query restoration has been updated across `@tanstack/query-core`, `@tanstack/query-persist-client-core`, and the framework adapters so restored entries behave as cached query snapshots rather than fresh success fetches:

- **`createPersisterRestoreResult` helper ([utils.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fxs9ye40/packages/query-core/src/utils.ts#L431-L459), [types.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fxs9ye40/packages/query-core/src/types.ts#L122-L154), [index.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fxs9ye40/packages/query-core/src/index.ts#L30))**:
  - Exported [`createPersisterRestoreResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fxs9ye40/packages/query-core/src/utils.ts#L431-L446) from `@tanstack/query-core`, accepting `{ data, state }` and returning a symbol-tagged [`PersisterRestoreResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fxs9ye40/packages/query-core/src/types.ts#L125-L132) accepted by [`QueryPersister`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fxs9ye40/packages/query-core/src/types.ts#L139-L154).
- **Snapshot state adoption in [`Query.fetch`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fxs9ye40/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L559-L611) & [`QueryObserver.createResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fxs9ye40/packages/query-core/src/queryObserver.ts#L469-L482)**:
  - When a persister returns a [`PersisterRestoreResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fxs9ye40/packages/query-core/src/types.ts#L125-L132), [`Query.fetch`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fxs9ye40/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L559-L611) adopts the restored state directly with `fetchStatus: 'idle'` instead of calling `setData` or invoking cache `onSuccess`/`onSettled` callbacks, preserving `status`, `error`, `isRefetchError`, counters (`dataUpdateCount`, `errorUpdateCount`, `fetchFailureCount`, `fetchFailureReason`), timestamps (`dataUpdatedAt`, `errorUpdatedAt`), `fetchMeta`, `isInvalidated`, and infinite-query `pageParams`.
  - Updated [`infiniteQueryBehavior`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fxs9ye40/packages/query-core/src/infiniteQueryBehavior.ts#L20-L30) to read `pages` and `pageParams` when `fetchFn` executes rather than before `persister` runs, and updated [`QueryObserver.createResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fxs9ye40/packages/query-core/src/queryObserver.ts#L469-L478) so optimistic mount state does not wipe persisted `failureCount`/`failureReason` when cached data is present.
- **Fine-grained single and bulk restoration ([createPersister.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fxs9ye40/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L216-L528))**:
  - Updated [`persisterFn`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fxs9ye40/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L216-L266) in [`experimental_createQueryPersister`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fxs9ye40/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L96) to return `createPersisterRestoreResult({ data: persistedQuery.state.data, state: persistedQuery.state })`.
  - Updated [`restoreQueries`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fxs9ye40/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L303-L535) to restore full query snapshots and independently reconcile `dataUpdatedAt` and `errorUpdatedAt` when merging with existing in-memory queries.
